info.title: tabularius Data API and OData
info.description: The FileMaker Data API–compatible REST API and the OData v4 service of a Tabularius server, written from the server's route table (docs/reference/rest.md). Response schemas come from the response contract (packages/server/test/dataapi-response-contract.json), which a test holds the server to; where a route has none, the schema is read off the documented example and marked x-tabularius-inferred. Operations and fields that FileMaker's own API does not have are marked x-tabularius-only or x-tabularius. This describes what Tabularius does, not what FileMaker Server does.

tags.name: Data API: sessions and sign-in
tags.description: The FileMaker Data API–compatible REST API lives under /fmi/data/{version}/, where version is vLatest, v1 or v2. Sign in with HTTP Basic at POST …/databases/{database}/sessions; the token comes back in the body and in the X-FM-Data-Access-Token header, and later calls send it as Authorization: Bearer {token}. A session idles out after 15 minutes (Data API sessions always do; a web-client session whose privilege set turns idle disconnect off stays signed in for up to 24 hours idle instead, and a disabled account's session ends at once). Every reply is {"response": …, "messages": [{"code", "message"}]}, with code "0" on success; on an error the response is {} and the code is a FileMaker error code (952 for a bad token, 212 for a failed sign-in, 3 "Command is unavailable" with 404 for an unknown path).

tags.name: Data API: files, layouts and scripts
tags.description: Information about the server and its hosted files, and the per-session global fields. productInfo and the database list need no sign-in; the rest take a session token as Authorization: Bearer {token}. Layouts, scripts, fields and value lists the account's privilege set can't use are left out, and a layout-scoped API token sees only its layouts. Replies use the {"response", "messages"} envelope.

tags.name: Data API: records, finds and scripts
tags.description: Reading and writing records through a layout, finding, uploading to container fields and running scripts, at /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/…. Every route takes a session token as Authorization: Bearer {token} and runs with the account's privilege set: records it can't view are left out and fields it can't see are omitted. Record requests take script, script.prerequest and script.presort (each with a .param) and answer with scriptResult and scriptError; a script's error is reported there, not as an HTTP error. An explicitly tagged terminal privilege error adds tabularius:denial (operation, permission, safe explanation), with .prerequest or .presort suffixes for those phases. Get ( LastErrorDetail ) returns the same safe sentence while that error remains current; a handled error with final scriptError 0 adds no denial extension. recordId and modId are strings. FileMaker errors such as 101 (record missing), 102 (field missing), 105 (layout missing) and 306 (modId mismatch) come back with status 500.

tags.name: OData
tags.description: OData v4 over hosted files at /fmi/odata/v4, like FileMaker Server's OData API, so Excel, Power BI and other OData clients connect directly. Entity sets are table occurrences; records are keyed by ROWID (the record id) and ROWMODID is the modification count; names that aren't OData identifiers have those characters replaced with "_". Sign in per file with HTTP Basic, a Data API session token or an API token; the privilege set needs fmodata, and record, field and script access apply. Responses carry OData-Version: 4.0; errors answer {"error":{"code":"…","message":"…"}} (code as text), and a 401 carries WWW-Authenticate: Basic. A read-only API token may only GET (403 code "9"). HEAD is answered on every address GET is, with GET's status and headers and no body; a method an address doesn't take answers 405 with Allow.

post.summary: Signs in to a hosted file with an account name and password and returns a session token.
post.description:
**Permissions:** HTTP Basic with a local account's name and password, or, when an LDAP/Active Directory server is configured, a directory name and password that matches one of the file's external accounts. The privilege set must have fmrest (fmapp or fmwebdirect when X-Tabularius-Client: web is sent), else 9 (401). A local-only account may sign in only from the server itself (212, 401).

The token is also sent in the X-FM-Data-Access-Token response header. A wrong name or password is 212 (401), and after too many failures 212 says when to try again. An account with an authenticator app set up and no X-Tabularius-OTP gets 1211 (401), as does a wrong code. When a second factor is required (the file requires one for full-access accounts, or the account is set to require one) and a passkey is the account's only second factor, the answer is 9000 (401): sign in at …/sessions/passkey-2fa instead. A full-access account without any second factor (authenticator app or passkey), when the file requires one, or an account set to require one, is refused with 9 (403) (a passkey counts as a second factor). When the account owes a password change the response adds "passwordChangeRequired": true, and the session may only change its password (PATCH …/sessions) or sign out. An unknown file is 802 (404).

parameters.name: X-Tabularius-OTP
parameters.description: The one-time code, for an account with an authenticator app set up

parameters.name: X-Tabularius-Client
parameters.description: "web" for a web-client session (needs fmapp or fmwebdirect instead of fmrest)

200.description: Signs in to a hosted file with an account name and password and returns a session token.

fmDataSource.description: External file credentials: {database, username, password}. At most 20 entries; a longer list is 960 (400) before any password check. Repeated database names are ignored case-insensitively after the first entry.

patch.summary: Changes the signed-in account's own password, which clears an owed password change for the session.
patch.description:
**Permissions:** A valid session token for the file (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token); allowed even when the session owes a password change. Changes only the session's own account.

Every other session of the account is signed out; the one making the change stays. A missing newPassword is 960 (400); a wrong current password 212 (401); a new password equal to the old one, or one the policy rejects, 960 (400).

200.description: Changes the signed-in account's own password, which clears an owed password change for the session.

newPassword.description: The new password; must differ from the current one and meet the file's password policy

delete.summary: Signs out: ends the session the path names, releasing its record locks.
delete.description:
**Permissions:** None beyond knowing the token: the token in the path is the credential, and no Authorization header is read.

Answers {} whether or not the token was live.

200.description: Signs out: ends the session the path names, releasing its record locks.

get.summary: Checks whether a session token is still live, without resetting its idle timer.
get.description:
**Permissions:** Authorization: Bearer {token} (only the Authorization header is read here); a missing, unknown or idle token is 952 (401).

Checking a token does not keep it alive, as on FileMaker Server: only calls that use the token do.

200.description: Checks whether a session token is still live, without resetting its idle timer.

post.summary: Signs in with a passkey: without an assertion it issues a challenge; with one it verifies it and returns a session token.
post.description:
**Permissions:** None to start; the passkey assertion is the credential. The account's privilege set must still have fmrest (fmapp or fmwebdirect with X-Tabularius-Client: web), and a local-only account may sign in only from the server itself.

The second step answers {"token": …} (plus "passwordChangeRequired": true when one is owed) and sets X-FM-Data-Access-Token. The rpId and origin come from --public-url when it is set, else from the request's Host (or X-Forwarded-Host / X-Forwarded-Proto, believed only from a reverse proxy on the server's own computer, which must overwrite them; behind any other proxy set --public-url). A challenge is good once, for 5 minutes; an expired, replayed, unknown or failing assertion, or an inactive account, is 212 (401).

200.description: Signs in with a passkey: without an assertion it issues a challenge; with one it verifies it and returns a session token.

account.description: First step only: the account, so its credential ids come back in allowCredentials

response.description: Second step: the assertion, {credentialId, clientDataJSON, authenticatorData, signature, challenge} (base64url strings; challenge is the one issued)

post.summary: Signs in with a password and a passkey as the second factor: without an assertion it issues a challenge; with one it verifies it and returns a session token.
post.description:
**Permissions:** HTTP Basic with the account's name and password (the first factor is checked on both steps), and the account must have a passkey. The privilege set must have fmrest (fmapp or fmwebdirect with X-Tabularius-Client: web).

Unlike …/sessions/passkey, this does not replace the password. allowCredentials lists only this account's own passkeys. The second step answers {"token": …} (plus "passwordChangeRequired": true when one is owed) and sets X-FM-Data-Access-Token. A wrong name or password is 212 (401); an account with no passkey is 1211 (401); a failing assertion is answered with its error in 401 and is recorded as a failed two-factor sign-in.

200.description: Signs in with a password and a passkey as the second factor: without an assertion it issues a challenge; with one it verifies it and returns a session token.

response.description: Second step: the assertion, {credentialId, clientDataJSON, authenticatorData, signature, challenge} (base64url strings; challenge is the one issued). Leave the body empty for the first step.

post.summary: Signs in with one of the account's one-time recovery codes and returns a session token.
post.description:
**Permissions:** None beyond the account name and an unused recovery code; each code works once. The privilege set must have fmrest (fmapp or fmwebdirect with X-Tabularius-Client: web).

A wrong, used or missing code is 212 "That recovery code is not valid" (401); repeated failures are blocked for a while. The token is also sent in X-FM-Data-Access-Token.

200.description: Signs in with one of the account's one-time recovery codes and returns a session token.

code.description: A recovery code, such as a1b2-c3d4-e5f6

post.summary: Makes a fresh set of ten recovery codes for the signed-in account, replacing any it had, and returns them once.
post.description: **Permissions:** A valid session token for the file (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token); acts only on the session's own account.

200.description: Makes a fresh set of ten recovery codes for the signed-in account, replacing any it had, and returns them once.

post.summary: Starts registering a passkey for the signed-in account: returns a challenge and the credential ids it already has.
post.description: **Permissions:** A valid session token for the file; acts only on the session's own account.

200.description: Starts registering a passkey for the signed-in account: returns a challenge and the credential ids it already has.

post.summary: Finishes registering a passkey for the signed-in account and returns its credential id.
post.description:
**Permissions:** A valid session token for the file; the challenge must have been issued to the same account.

An expired or already used challenge, or an attestation that does not verify, is error 960.

200.description: Finishes registering a passkey for the signed-in account and returns its credential id.

label.description: A name for the passkey, such as the device

get.summary: Lists the signed-in account's passkeys, newest first.
get.description:
**Permissions:** A valid session token for the file; lists only the session's own account.

200.description: Lists the signed-in account's passkeys, newest first.

delete.summary: Removes one of the signed-in account's own passkeys.
delete.description: **Permissions:** A valid session token for the file; a credential id that isn't the session account's own is 9 "Not your passkey" (403).

200.description: Removes one of the signed-in account's own passkeys.

get.summary: Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 description of the Data API and OData this server answers.
get.description:
**Permissions:** None: no credentials are read, and nothing in it depends on a file or an account.

Written from the route table in this reference and the response contract, not by hand: a test fails when a route here has no operation in it, or an operation has no route. Operations that FileMaker's own API does not have carry `x-tabularius-only`; a response schema read off the documented example, not checked key by key, carries `x-tabularius-inferred`. `servers` is this server's own address (the --public-url when one is set). For TypeScript types of the same description, run `tabularius api-types > tabularius-api.d.ts`. Any other method is 405 code 3. See docs/openapi.md.

tags: Data API: files, layouts and scripts
get.summary: Lists the file's layouts in its order, in folders, with each layout's table.
get.description:
**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). Layouts the privilege set has no access to, and layouts outside a layout-scoped token's list, are left out.

Empty folders are left out; layouts not in the file's order (made since) come last.

200.description: Lists the file's layouts in its order, in folders, with each layout's table.

tags: Data API: files, layouts and scripts
get.summary: Returns a layout's field metadata, its portals' field metadata and the value lists its fields use.
get.description:
**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). A layout the set can't use, or outside a layout-scoped token's list, is 105 "Layout … is missing" (500). Fields the set can't see, and value lists it has no access to, are left out. A masked field is listed, with result text whatever its type.

type is normal, calculation or summary; result is text, number, date, time, timeStamp or container. displayType is how the layout shows the field: editText, popupList, popupMenu, checkBox, radioButtons, calendar or secureText (a concealed edit box), and editText for a field not on the layout. Related fields on the layout appear as "TO::Field". valueLists is left out when the layout uses none; lists of related values are left out.

200.description: Returns a layout's field metadata, its portals' field metadata and the value lists its fields use.

Separators show as "-". Empty folders are left out.

patch.summary: Sets global fields for this session only.
patch.description:
**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). Each field is set under the privilege set. A read-only API token is refused writes and scripts with 9 (403).

A missing or non-object globalFields is 958 (400); a value that is not a string or number is 960 (400).

200.description: Sets global fields for this session only.

globalFields.description: {"Table::Field": value}, each value a string or number

tags: Data API: records, finds and scripts
get.summary: Returns a range of records from the layout's table.
get.description:
**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). Records the privilege set can't view are left out; a masked field comes back as its stand-in, never its value. A read-only API token may read but not run scripts.

When the layout has portals, each record's portalData holds their rows (each with recordId and modId) and portalDataInfo gives portalObjectName, database, table, foundCount and returnedCount for each. Records may also carry "updating" (fields showing a value from before the latest change) "styles" (text formatting by field) and "portalStyles" (the same for portal rows), which FileMaker's Data API does not have.

parameters.name: _offset
parameters.description: The first record, 1-based (default 1); a whole number of 1 or more, else 960 (400)

parameters.name: _limit
parameters.description: How many records (default 100); a whole number of 0 to 10,000 (`TABULARIUS_DATA_API_MAX_LIMIT`, 0 for no cap), else 960 (400); more is refused, not cut down

parameters.name: _sort
parameters.description: JSON array of {fieldName, sortOrder}; anything else is 960 (400)

parameters.name: portal
parameters.description: The portals to include, as a JSON array or a comma-separated list (default all)

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: A script to run after the action; its result comes back as scriptResult and scriptError

parameters.name: script.prerequest
parameters.description: A script to run before the action (scriptResult.prerequest, scriptError.prerequest)

parameters.name: script.presort
parameters.description: A script to run before sorting (scriptResult.presort, scriptError.presort)

x-tabularius-query-patterns.name: _limit.{portal}
x-tabularius-query-patterns.description: How many related rows in that portal

tags: Data API: records, finds and scripts
post.summary: Creates a record and returns its recordId and modId.
post.description:
**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). The privilege set must allow creating records in the table and editing the fields given. A read-only API token is refused writes and scripts with 9 (403).

An unknown field is 102 (500). Invalid JSON is 960 (400). With portalData the record and its related records are made together as one transaction: if any portal row is refused (no privilege, a bad field), nothing is created. A portalData that is not an object of arrays of rows, or a row with a recordId, is 960 (400). The reply is the new record's own recordId and modId; related records do not change its modId.

200.description: Creates a record and returns its recordId and modId.

fieldData.description: Field names and values (may be empty)

portalData.description: {"Portal": [{"TO::Field": value}]}: each row makes one related record. A row may not carry a recordId.

patch.summary: Edits a record, and optionally its portal rows, and returns the new modId.
patch.description:
**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). The privilege set must allow editing the record and fields. A read-only API token is refused writes and scripts with 9 (403).

A stale modId is 306 (500). styles for a field without a value in fieldData, or not valid, is 960 (400); portalStyles for a row not in portalData is 960 (400). When portal rows were added, the reply also has newPortalRecordInfo, an array of {tableName, recordId, modId} for each related record made.

modId.description: When given, the edit is refused with 306 unless it matches the record's modId

styles.description: Text formatting runs by field, for fields also in fieldData (a Tabularius addition)

portalStyles.description: Text formatting runs for portal rows: portal, then the row's recordId, then "TO::Field"; each field must have a value in that row of portalData (a Tabularius addition)

Add /{repetition} for another repetition, and ?portal=<name>&portalRecordId=<id> for a portal row, as for a single upload. An account may have 4 uploads going in a file (a fifth is 212, 429) and all accounts together 8 GiB of declared sizes (413); a size over 1 GiB is 413, a size that is not a whole number of 1 or more is 400. Uploads wait in TABULARIUS_UPLOAD_TMP, are dropped after TABULARIUS_UPLOAD_IDLE_HOURS (24) without a byte arriving (asking how far one has got does not count), and do not survive a restart.

post.summary: Finds records with one or more find requests and returns a range of the found set.
post.description:
**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). Records the privilege set can't view are left out; a masked field comes back as its stand-in and can't be searched or sorted by (an error). Allowed for a read-only API token, but not with scripts.

A missing or empty query is 10 "Requested data is missing" (400). No matches is 401 "No records match the request" (HTTP 400). Find criteria support ! and !text for duplicate values, // for today (also in ranges), ? for invalid nonempty dates, times and timestamps, # for one digit, and ~text for relaxed accent, kana and Unicode compatibility matching. Duplicate values are determined before other criteria and omit requests. Text duplicates compare the first 100 characters; repeated values must occur in distinct records. Quoted or backslash-escaped wildcards are literal. Unsupported criteria (for example, a bare ~ or a container duplicate find) return FileMaker code 400 with HTTP 400.

200.description: Finds records with one or more find requests and returns a range of the found set.

query.description: Find requests: field names to criteria; "omit": "true" makes a request omit

offset.description: The first record, 1-based (default 1); a string of digits works too; anything but a whole number of 1 or more is 960 (400)

limit.description: How many records (default 100); a whole number of 0 to 10,000 (`TABULARIUS_DATA_API_MAX_LIMIT`, 0 for no cap), else 960 (400); more is refused, not cut down

script.description: A script to run after the action; its result comes back as scriptResult and scriptError

script.prerequest.description: A script to run before the action (scriptResult.prerequest, scriptError.prerequest)

script.presort.description: A script to run before sorting (scriptResult.presort, scriptError.presort)

^offset\\..+$.description: The first related row in that portal

^limit\\..+$.description: How many related rows in that portal

tags: Data API: records, finds and scripts
get.summary: Runs a script on a layout and returns its result.
get.description:
**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). The privilege set must be able to run the script; a script it can't run or that doesn't exist comes back as a scriptError, not an HTTP error. A read-only API token is refused with 9 (403).

A missing script answers 200 with scriptError "104". Tagged terminal privilege errors optionally add tabularius:denial; handled errors do not. Each outward Data API request, web request or interactive script run, and MCP tool invocation audits only its first tagged refused check, even if a script handles it. The owning file records captured effective-account and policy metadata after cleanup and rollback. Hidden objects, filtering and redaction create no privilege-denied events. Repeats are suppressed for ten minutes, with 500 keys per file and separate admission and append-attempt budgets of 60/minute each; immediate, deferred and retried writes share the append budget. Diagnostics captured during trials are suppressed, while already captured production refusals wait for trial release. Deferred writes expire after ten minutes; failed appends get at most three attempts. Aggregate failure/drop counters contain no exception text. This is a sampled, process-local history, not a count of attempts or durable exactly-once delivery. Metadata and configuration names can contain personal text. Scheduled/background jobs and other protocol adapters remain deferred; policy fingerprints are not historical snapshots.

200.description: Runs a script on a layout and returns its result.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). Fields the account can't see are left out, and so are masked ones (they can't be selected, filtered or ordered by: 400).

Field types map to Edm.String (text, container), Edm.Decimal (number), Edm.Date, Edm.TimeOfDay and Edm.DateTimeOffset. Each relationship gives the entity sets at both ends a NavigationProperty named after the other (Collection type), with a NavigationPropertyBinding on the entity set, when the account can see both tables and read every match field at both ends (a hidden or masked key would otherwise show through the related records). Only GET.

post.summary: Several requests in one: multipart/mixed (OData 4.0) or JSON (OData 4.01), each answered as it would be on its own. A change set (a multipart/mixed part inside the batch, or JSON requests sharing an atomicityGroup) is one transaction: if any of its requests fails, none of its changes are kept.
post.description:
**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"), once for the whole batch: every request in it has exactly that access, and a read-only API token's writes are refused (403 code "9") one by one.

A request's URL is relative to the file's service root, an absolute path or a full URL, and must be in the same file (400 code "3" otherwise); "$1" stands for what request 1 (its Content-ID or id) created. A failed change set is answered in multipart with its one error; in JSON, the request that failed says why and the rest of its group answer 424. A JSON request whose dependsOn names a failed request or group answers 424. Container files ($value of a container field) and a $batch inside a batch are refused (400). At most 1,000 requests and 32 MB; once the answers reach 64 MB, the requests after them answer 400 without running, and a change set that passes it keeps nothing. A Script.{name} call in a change set shares its transaction (the script can't open its own), and a script that ends with an error still answers 200, so it doesn't fail the set; Content-IDs are unique and hold no control characters. A body that isn't a batch is refused whole (400); only POST (405). A batch holds at most 1000 requests (400 otherwise), and at most 5 of them may be $crossjoin (the rest answer 400, each join runs a worker for up to 10 seconds).

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description: odata.continue-on-error: run the requests after one that fails (otherwise the batch stops there)

200.description: Several requests in one: multipart/mixed (OData 4.0) or JSON (OData 4.01), each answered as it would be on its own. A change set (a multipart/mixed part inside the batch, or JSON requests sharing an atomicityGroup) is one transaction: if any of its requests fails, none of its changes are kept.

post.summary: Runs a script, with a parameter, and answers its result.
post.description:
**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). The privilege set must be able to run the script (403 code "9"); a read-only API token is refused. Scripts run offline unless the server allows network access.

Global variables last between calls by the same account. Only POST (405 code "3").

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Script name (exact, else case-insensitive), or FMSID:{id} for its id (so renaming the script breaks nothing); 404 code "104" when missing

post.summary: Creates a table, with its fields, as FileMaker Server's OData schema changes do. Like a table made in Design mode, it gets a table occurrence (so it is an entity set straight away) and a layout.
post.description:
**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"), and [Full Access] (403 code "9" otherwise). Logged as a design change under the account.

An unknown type, default or field property answers 400 with what is wrong. Schema changes can't be part of a $batch change set (400): a rolled-back set would leave the design changed. PATCH /FileMaker_Tables/{table} with {"fields":[…]} adds fields (200, the table as above); DELETE /FileMaker_Tables/{table} deletes the table and DELETE /FileMaker_Tables/{table}/{field} a field (204; 404 code "100" or "102" when missing). A deleted table or field can be restored from Design mode. FileMaker_Tables and FileMaker_Indexes are reserved, as on FileMaker Server: a table occurrence of either name is not an entity set.

201.description: Creates a table, with its fields, as FileMaker Server's OData schema changes do. Like a table made in Design mode, it gets a table occurrence (so it is an entity set straight away) and a layout.

fields.description: Fields: {name, type, nullable, primary, unique, global, repetitions, default}. type is VARCHAR or CHARACTER VARYING (an optional length becomes a maximum-characters check), NUMERIC, DECIMAL, INT, DATE, TIME, TIMESTAMP, or BLOB, VARBINARY, LONGVARBINARY or BINARY VARYING (container). nullable false = not empty; primary = not empty and unique; default = USER, USERNAME, CURRENT_USER, CURRENT_DATE, CURDATE, CURRENT_TIME, CURTIME, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURTIMESTAMP or NOW (an auto-enter creation value)

post.summary: Indexes a field: {"indexName": "field"}. DELETE /FileMaker_Indexes/{table}/{field} removes its index (204).
post.description:
**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"), and [Full Access] (403 code "9" otherwise).

Sets the field's value index and builds it, so finds and sorts on it stop reading every record. Unstored calculations, summaries, globals and containers can't be indexed (400 code "102").

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: The table to index a field of

201.description: Indexes a field: {"indexName": "field"}. DELETE /FileMaker_Indexes/{table}/{field} removes its index (204).

get.summary: Records of an entity set, with $filter, $search, $select, $orderby, $top, $skip, $count and $expand; pages follow @odata.nextLink.
get.description:
**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). Only records and fields the account can view.

$compute=Expression as Name,... works out a property for each record of a list (the expressions are those of $filter, the names new ones): $select shows it and $filter can use it; $orderby on it answers 501, and it cannot be used with $apply. $levels answers 501, and so do options inside $expand other than $select, $filter, $orderby, $top and $skip; an unknown navigation property is 400 code "102"; other unknown $ options 400 code "8310". Related records follow record and field access as the records themselves do. A navigation property may be named once (400 otherwise). A page whose related records pass 20,000 ends early, with @odata.nextLink carrying on from there; a single record or navigation past that is 400. Filter and orderby errors are 400 (code "102" for an unknown or unstored property). Timestamps come back with Z.

parameters.name: entitySet
parameters.description: Entity set (or table occurrence) name; 404 code "102" when unknown

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: eq ne gt ge lt le in, and or not, add sub mul div mod, contains startswith endswith indexof concat substring length tolower toupper trim year month day hour minute second date time round floor ceiling now mindatetime maxdatetime totaloffsetminutes, cast(value, Edm.String|Int32|Double|Date…); only stored fields. Related records: Orders/any(o: o/Total gt 50) and Orders/all(o: …) test the related records the account may view (all passes with none; at most 3 deep and 20 per filter; up to 20,000 related records are read, 400 past that; 400 inside $expand, $apply and $crossjoin). At most 1,000,000 characters and 10,000 names, values and operators, nested at most 32 deep (400 past any of these)

parameters.name: $search
parameters.description: Free text over the stored text fields the account can see: words (all must appear, in any fields), "phrases", AND, OR, NOT and parentheses. A-Z ignore case. Number, date and time fields aren't searched. At most 100 terms, nested at most 32 deep; inside a phrase only \" and \\ are escapes. Applies with $filter and on /$count; a $search that can't be read is 400

parameters.name: $orderby
parameters.description: Property [asc|desc], …; only stored fields (ROWID order is the default)

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: Records to skip ($skiptoken is read the same way)

parameters.name: $apply
parameters.description: Groups and totals: filter(…) steps, then one groupby((A,B)[,aggregate(…)]) or aggregate(…); aggregates are "Property with sum|min|max|average|countdistinct as Name" or "$count as Name". Only stored fields; $filter, $orderby, $top, $skip and $count then work on the rows it gives, which have no ROWID ($select and $expand: 400; other transformations: 501). Reads at most 500,000 records (400: filter first)

parameters.name: $expand
parameters.description: Navigation properties to put inline, comma-separated (* for all), each optionally with ($select=…;$filter=…;$orderby=…;$top=n;$skip=n), the options separated by ;; up to 1,000 related records come for each record (with $filter or $orderby, every match is read first)

200.description: Records of an entity set, with $filter, $search, $select, $orderby, $top, $skip, $count and $expand; pages follow @odata.nextLink.

get.description:

The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). Each set is read as the account sees it: only records it can view, and only fields it can read can be named.

Only GET. Reads at most 100,000 records of each set (and 64 MB of the text  and  name), joins at most 500,000 combinations, and stops a join that runs past 10 s (400 past any of these: narrow each set with a condition on it alone). The join runs in a process of its own, at most 2 at once (503 past that). $select is not supported at the top level; use $expand(…;$select=…).

patch.summary: Changes fields of a record; If-Match guards against changes made since it was read.
patch.description:
**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). The account must be able to edit the record (403) and modify the fields (400 code "201"). A read-only API token is refused.
